the כדתניא of 16b.4-5 (continuing at 16b.6, next piska)

props.gloss_en: and he says before them twenty-four blessings: the eighteen of every day, and he adds to them six more
as we learned: for the seventh he says 'Blessed... Who has mercy on the land'
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: what is 'the seventh'? the seventh for length
in [the blessing] 'Redeemer of Israel' he lengthens
and at its close he says: He Who answered Abraham on Mount Moriah, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry this day
and they answer amen after him
and the synagogue attendant says to them: blow, sons of Aaron, blow
and he resumes and says: He Who answered our fathers at the Red Sea, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry this day
and they answer amen after him, and the synagogue attendant says to them: sound the teru'a, sons of Aaron
and so for each and every blessing: at one he says 'blow' and at the next 'sound the teru'a'
